findings.summary: Bounded primary-source research found the supporting native proposal incorrectly claimed mountinfo exposes no idmapped indication. Upstream Linux v6.8 show_mnt_opts emits idmapped in the per-mount options field and show_mountinfo calls it before tagged fields. The factual docs correction retains trusted-root attestation, current authenticated association, complete source/pin/positive-feasibility freeze and all integration/runtime gates; no decoder, reader, permission rule or authority behavior is added.
